_comment: EXAMPLE staging file for tools/pead-scanner.js (Brique 1 — PEAD / earnings-drift, VOIE B). The AGENT (claude -p / /scanner) calls the MCP mcp__marketdata__* tools, extracts the fields below per ticker, and writes THIS file. The node ingest script PARSES it — it never calls the MCP (OAuth2, zero token). Zero fabrication: every field comes from an MCP call. If the agent's MCP step fails, DO NOT write this file with invented data — either omit it or set mcp_ok:false so the ingest marks the run incomplete + exits non-zero (pipeline alerts).

_provenance.GetEarningsCalendarFiltered: universe of recent prints + implied move + next-earnings window (days_until_next_earnings, exclusion window)
_provenance.QueryData:earnings_quarterly: eps_actual, eps_est, rev_actual, rev_est, beats_streak (consecutive beats)
_provenance.QueryData:analyst_actions,financials: guidance_raised (guidance raised at the quarter), post-print analyst revisions
_provenance.QueryData:technicals,bars_daily: prev_close, open_print, close_now, high_gap_day, low_gap_day, ema20, atr14, ext_ema20, resistance_preprint, nearest_resistance
_provenance.QueryData:unusual_options: call_skew (bullish flow confirmation — score bonus, not eliminatory)
_provenance.QueryData:sec_filings,flags: dilution.{dilution_risk_score, atm_active, shelf_active, disqualify, reason} (offering post-earnings = disqualifying)
_provenance.GetMarketContext:regime: global regime (also passable via --regime); a beat in a hostile regime drifts less → score penalty

prints.name: SoFi Technologies
